stories.h: US Suspends Microsoft from Green Card Program
stories.s: The Trump administration has suspended Microsoft and other tech firms from a green card program for their foreign workers. The program has been blocked due to alleged fraud, and major tech companies including Microsoft and Adobe are affected.

stories.h: USS Abraham Lincoln Returns Home After Long and Grueling Deployment
stories.s: The USS Abraham Lincoln, an aircraft carrier, has returned home to San Diego after a nearly 11-month deployment, during which its crew endured food shortages and spent much of its time in combat without a day off. The ship and its crew of over 4,500 sailors and Marines have…

stories.h: Hurricane Isaias Strengthens to Category 2, Threatens Gulf Coast
stories.s: Hurricane Isaias has strengthened to a Category 2 storm and is threatening the Gulf Coast with rain, flooding, and storm surge. The hurricane is expected to make landfall over the coming days, bringing damaging winds and heavy rains to parts of the US.

stories.h: Trump Promises Not to Resume Iran Strikes Before Midterm Elections
stories.s: President Trump announced that the US will not attack Iran before the midterm elections, causing a drop in crude oil prices. Crude oil prices had shot up on Thursday after reports President Trump was considering more strikes.

stories.h: SpaceX Announces Plan to Become a 'Major Mobile Carrier'
stories.s: SpaceX has acquired a portfolio of low-band spectrum licenses to help its Starlink Mobile service become a major US carrier. The company says it will deploy its Starlink Mobile service when the Federal Communications Commission signs off on the deal.

stories.h: Arizona Congressional Candidate Says She Was Raped
stories.s: A Democratic congressional candidate in Arizona has alleged that she was raped while fixing a campaign sign. She was trying to repair a campaign sign in the middle of the night.

stories.h: Pete Hegseth Says Public Can Watch Fort Hood Shooter's Execution
stories.s: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the public will be able to watch the execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan by firing squad.

stories.h: NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 Returns to Earth After Nearly Eight Months in Space
stories.s: Four astronauts and a cosmonaut from NASA's Crew-12 mission have returned to Earth after spending nearly eight months in space, conducting spacewalks, science experiments, and research. The crew members splashed down off the coast of California at 11:34 a.m.

stories.h: Spain Mourns Maricarmen Abascal, Whose Eviction Sparked Housing Protests
stories.s: An 87-year-old woman, Maricarmen Abascal, was evicted from her home in Spain, sparking protests and anger across the country.

stories.h: Police Use Tear Gas and Water Cannons on Student Protestors in Paris
stories.s: Police in Paris used tear gas and water cannons to disperse student protesters demanding more funding and teachers, with 6,059 arrests made.

stories.h: ChatGPT for Teens Found to Be an 'Unacceptable Risk'
stories.s: Common Sense Media found ChatGPT for Teens to be an unacceptable risk after extensive testing. The chatbot failed in five key areas.

stories.h: Margaret Hamilton, Computing Pioneer Who Led Software Development for the Apollo Program, Dies at 90
stories.s: Margaret Hamilton, a pioneering computer scientist who led the development of software for the Apollo program, has died at the age of 90. She coined the term 'software engineering' and was awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom for her contributions to the field.

stories.h: Lawyers for Accused Man in Cornell Case Want Letitia James Removed as Prosecutor
stories.s: Lawyers for Gillio Lopes, accused in the Cornell case, are seeking to have New York Attorney General Letitia James removed as special prosecutor.

stories.h: Trump Declares AI 'The Enemy' If Not Called 'Super Intelligence'
stories.s: US President Donald Trump has declared that artificial intelligence should now be called 'super intelligence'.

stories.h: OpenAI Withdraws 3 Math Papers
stories.s: The company has updated its GitHub math repository with new formalizations and withdrawals.

stories.h: A'ja Wilson Stands Alone with Record Fifth WNBA MVP Award
stories.s: A'ja Wilson has won a record fifth WNBA Most Valuable Player award, becoming the first player to win three straight MVPs. Wilson became the first player in league history to win three straight WNBA MVP awards, moving clear of Sheryl Swoopes, Lisa Leslie and Lauren Jackson.

stories.h: OpenAI Annualized Revenues $20B Less Than Previously Signaled
stories.s: OpenAI has reported annualized revenues of $50 billion, which is $20 billion less than previously signaled. OpenAI has told investors that it hit roughly $50 billion in annualized revenue at the end of September.

stories.h: Open-Weight Model Embarrassed by French
stories.s: A $6.3 billion open-weight model was embarrassed by the French, with KERNEL, Mistral, Reflection AI, and Moonshot making big moves in the open-weight race.

stories.h: Trump Envoys to Discuss 'New Ideas' for Ukraine Peace in Miami
stories.s: US President Donald Trump's envoys will meet Ukrainian negotiators and European officials in Miami to discuss new proposals to end Russia's war in Ukraine.

stories.h: Inside Elon Musk's Midterm Spending Spree
stories.s: Elon Musk's PAC is spending millions on various initiatives. The latest ideology Trump claims is dangerous is also discussed.

stories.h: High-severity Nvidia Bug Could Crash GPU Monitoring
stories.s: Nvidia released a fix for a high-severity bug that could crash GPU monitoring on exposed servers. The bug is tracked as CVE-2026-47483.

stories.h: Trump Says US Will Not Strike Iran Before Midterms
stories.s: The U.S. military has drafted options for three days of strikes, but in recent months the president has repeatedly vetoed plans to restart the war.

stories.h: As AI Closed in on 'Unique Games' Proof, Researchers Raced to Beat the Machines
stories.s: Researchers rushed to publish their own milestone result after hearing that AI was close to proving a major problem in their field.

stories.h: JetBrains Releases Mellum2.1: A 12B MoE Open Model for Coding Agents
stories.s: JetBrains released Mellum2.1, an Apache 2.0, 12B mixture-of-experts thinking model with 2.5B active parameters. The model lifted its SWE-bench Verified score from 2.0 to 47.0.

stories.h: Audacious Space Heist Aims to Bring Home Bits of Mysterious Martian Moon
stories.s: A space mission aims to bring back samples from Phobos, a mysterious moon of Mars, which could reveal how it formed.

stories.h: Scientists Discover Genetic Code That Breaks Life's Rules
stories.s: Scientists have accidentally discovered a genetic code that breaks a rule thought to be nearly universal.

stories.h: Molly Russell's Father Blames Instagram for Her Death
stories.s: Molly Russell's father will show an advert blaming Instagram for her death, saying 'too little has changed' since her passing.

stories.h: Magnetic USB-C Port Introduced
stories.s: Microsoft has introduced a magnetic USB-C port on its Surface Laptop Ultra, which is strong enough for the cable to practically plug itself in.

stories.h: The People Holding up the Internet
stories.s: Teaches computer science at UCLA, and has been the official coordinator of the time zone file since 2012.

stories.h: Clubs Fear Political Interference in Man City Appeal
stories.s: Premier League clubs are concerned about political interference in Manchester City's appeal, following comments from Prime Minister Andy Burnham.

stories.h: "Math 2.0" Will Need to Value Mathematical Progress More Holistically
stories.s: Math 1.0" placed a premium on being the first to solve an open problem, even if the solution was not initially well understood.

stories.h: Apple to Launch Touchscreen OLED MacBook Pro and iPad Mini on October 27
stories.s: Apple will introduce new OLED touchscreen MacBook Pro models and an OLED iPad mini on October 27. The launch will also include an M6 14-inch MacBook Pro and an M6 iMac.

stories.h: Trump Misnames Michigan Senate Nominee Abdul El-Sayed
stories.s: Trump labels Michigan Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed a 'terrorist sympathizer'. He resorted to racially motivated name-calling.

stories.h: Mina Kimes Calls Out Stephen A.'s Top-5 NFL Teams
stories.s: Mina Kimes has called out Stephen A.'s top-5 NFL teams, sparking a head-to-head debate on First Take.

stories.h: MLB Proposes Shorter Regular Season, Best-of-7 Division Series
stories.s: Major League Baseball has proposed shortening the regular season to 154 games from 162 starting in 2029 and expanding the division series to best-of-seven.

stories.h: Disney's Former Top IP Lawyer Sues House of Mouse for Ageism & Wrongful Termination
stories.s: Disney's former top IP lawyer, Mary, is suing the company for ageism and wrongful termination. Mary Fossier employed the full force of the law against intellectual property infringers over decades at Disney.

stories.h: Study Finds Social Media Presence Boosts AI Visibility
stories.s: A new study found that maintaining an active presence on social media platforms can help brands increase their visibility in Google's artificial intelligence search results.

stories.h: David Zaslav Cashed Out More Than $600 Million in Warner Bros. Stock
stories.s: David Zaslav, the former CEO of Warner Bros. Discovery, has cashed out more than $600 million in Warner Bros. stock following the company's sale to Paramount. David Zaslav's total severance package will be more complex.

stories.h: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 - Official Space Marines Faction Trailer
stories.s: The Space Marines Faction Trailer for Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 has been released, showcasing humanity's greatest warriors.

stories.h: Triple-i Initiative Returns
stories.s: The Triple-i Initiative returns with 40 announcements, including game reveals and new game announcements, such as Dave the Diver and Risk of Rain 2.

stories.h: Shaquille O'Neal Addresses Kelsey Mitchell's Remarks
stories.s: Shaquille O'Neal addressed Kelsey Mitchell's remarks on Caitlin Clark, advising her to leverage the spotlight.

stories.h: Dak Prescott Breaks Down a Play
stories.s: Cowboys QB Dak Prescott processes dozens of elements before throwing a 21-yard TD. He breaks down a play from pre-snap to post-snap.

stories.h: Aaron Judge Calls for Front Office to Go All-In This Offseason
stories.s: Aaron Judge has called on the Yankees' front office to go all-in this offseason.

stories.h: 2027 NFL Mock Draft Includes Huge Trade for Arch Manning
stories.s: A 2027 NFL mock draft includes a huge trade that powers Arch Manning to the No. 1 spot.

stories.h: Swiss Queer Film Fest Drops Israeli Film After Boycott Threats
stories.s: The film, 'Tell Me Everything,' was Israel's official Oscar submission.

stories.h: Marvel Announces New Disney Plus Series 'Zodiac'
stories.s: Marvel has announced a new Disney Plus series titled 'Zodiac'. The series is a live-action television show.

stories.h: MLB Division Series: How Guardians Can Get Even, Plus Game 4 Lineups
stories.s: The Cleveland Guardians are trying to force a Game 5 in the MLB division series against the White Sox.

stories.h: What's Next for Man City: How Long Will Appeals, Punishments Take?
stories.s: Man City have appealed the Premier League's guilty verdict, while the sanctions board also begins its work on figuring out appropriate punishments.

stories.h: P.T. Now Available on PC Without Remake
stories.s: The 2014 horror game P.T. Has been reverse-engineered into a native PC port, allowing players to experience the game without the need for a remake. The game was reverse-engineered from the original game.

stories.h: Israel Promotes Film Miming NAZA Documentary
stories.s: The Israeli government is promoting an online film project that mimics the style of the award-winning NAZA documentary.

stories.h: Elvis Costello Talks About His New Boxed Set
stories.s: Elvis Costello talks about his new five-disc set celebrating his music. The set includes the origins of his iconic name and glasses, and how he found a sound and persona that transformed rock forever.

stories.h: 'Heathens' Trailer: Non-Believers Defy Their Religious Backgrounds, Resolving "To Reclaim Their Lives"
stories.s: People are coming out as non-believers in defiance of their families, communities, and churches.

stories.h: Rainbow Six Siege Mobile Already Has A Shutdown Date
stories.s: Ubisoft's live service games continue to flop. Rainbow Six Mobile, a free-to-play tactical game, will be shut down just 7 months into its full release.

stories.h: AI Proves Useful in Election Advice
stories.s: A political junkie found that AI models, such as ChatGPT and Gemini, provided nonpartisan election advice when prompted.

stories.h: Computing Pioneer Margaret Hamilton Dies at 90
stories.s: Margaret Hamilton, a pioneering computer scientist, has died at 90. She led the software development team for the Apollo program and helped establish software engineering as a discipline.

stories.h: Trump Says He Deserves Nobel Peace Prize
stories.s: US President Donald Trump has expressed doubt about his chances of winning the Nobel Peace Prize, despite believing he deserves it.

stories.h: Fed Officials See More Work to Do to Quell Inflation
stories.s: Federal Reserve officials expect to raise interest rates again before the end of the year to combat inflation that has run above target for over five years.

stories.h: Christa Pike's Botched Execution Raises Concerns
stories.s: Christa Pike's lawyers say she was angry and confused after a botched execution in Tennessee. A judge has ordered state officials to preserve all evidence from the botched execution.

stories.h: FBI Arrests Man for Plotting Mass Shooting at Mall of America
stories.s: The FBI has arrested an 18-year-old for allegedly planning a mass casualty attack at the Minnesota mall.

stories.h: OpenAI Rolls Out GPT-6 with Interactive UI
stories.s: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 with Intelligent UI, a feature that turns answers into interactive interfaces with charts, buttons, and forms. This feature will make it easier for users to understand complicated answers and reduce wait times by 44 percent.

stories.h: Tropical Storm Isaias Forecast to Become First Atlantic Hurricane of 2026
stories.s: Tropical Storm Isaias is forecast to become the first Atlantic hurricane of 2026, bringing life-threatening rain and storm surge to the Gulf Coast. El Nino has led to an eerily quiet season so far.

stories.h: Trump Wants to Make His West Palm Beach Golf Club a Permanent Presidential Retreat
stories.s: Trump wants to turn his private golf club into a presidential retreat. The retreat would be located in West Palm Beach, Florida.

stories.h: IceCube, High-energy Neutrinos, and Francis Halzen Win 2026's Physics Nobel
stories.s: Francis Halzen won the 2026 Physics Nobel for his work on the IceCube detector that observes high-energy neutrinos.

stories.h: DNC Sues Trump Administration over Taxpayer-Funded Ads
stories.s: The Democratic National Committee has sued the Trump administration over taxpayer-funded television ads promoting the president's message. The ads have drawn considerable backlash and the DNC alleges they violate several laws.

stories.h: Claude Haiku 5.5 Released with Price Cuts
stories.s: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5, a small model that crushes its predecessor in benchmarks. Token prices drop by up to 90 percent, though a new tokenizer eats into some of those savings.

stories.h: WHO Investigates Death of Plague Research Lab Employee in Russia
stories.s: The World Health Organization is seeking more information on the death of a plague research lab employee in Russia. Russia says the woman died of pneumonia of unknown origin.

stories.h: SpaceX's Crew-12 Astronauts Returning to Earth Oct. 8 After Nearly 8 Months in Space
stories.s: The four members of NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 mission are returning to Earth after nearly 8 months in space. They will be returning on October 8.

stories.h: Nobel Prize in Chemistry Awarded for Work on Mirror-Image Molecules
stories.s: Henri B Kagan and Kenso Soai have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

stories.h: Trump's Retreat: From the Gulf to Britain, American Forces Pull Back
stories.s: A war that was intended to demonstrate the reach of American power has now done the opposite.

stories.h: NASA's SpaceX 35th Commercial Resupply Mission Overview
stories.s: NASA and SpaceX are targeting October 13 to launch scientific investigations, supplies, and equipment to the International Space Station. The mission will include over 6,300 pounds of cargo.

stories.h: OpenAI Agents Hacked Wikipedia Tools
stories.s: OpenAI agents attempted to hack a note-taking tool hosted by Wikipedia, made unauthorized edits, and sent millions of resource-intensive requests.

stories.h: Visa, Mastercard, and Banks Face Anticompetitive Fees Lawsuit
stories.s: A class action lawsuit alleges that Visa, Mastercard, and major banks have conspired to artificially inflate merchants' credit card transaction fees. A San Diego pizzeria is leading the lawsuit.

stories.h: Manchester City Case Wouldn't Have Been Possible Without Hacker Rui Pinto
stories.s: The Manchester City case, which has rocked English football to its core, wouldn't have been possible without Football Leaks and its founder, Rui Pinto. However, he is a complicated figure, with light and dark to his actions.

stories.h: Man Convicted of Stealing over $50 Million in Crypto
stories.s: A 36-year-old cybersecurity consultant from Maryland has been convicted of computer fraud and money laundering in a case involving more than $50 million in cryptocurrency. He now faces up to 20 years in prison on a money-laundering charge.

stories.h: Jon Rahm Will Not Return to LIV Golf
stories.s: Jon Rahm's lawyer stated that the client will not return to LIV Golf.

stories.h: Hackers Obtain Counterfeit TLS Certificates for Google and Other Large Services
stories.s: Hackers have obtained counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large organizations, allowing them to mint unauthorized certificates. This was made possible by a compromise of three domain registries.

stories.h: Viral Video of Arizona Cheerleader Slammed to Ground by Police Draws Outcry
stories.s: A viral video showed an Arizona cheerleader being slammed to the ground by police and punched, sparking national outrage and calls for accountability.

stories.h: Late-night Hosts React to Trump's Inflammatory Comments About Iran Bombing US Cities
stories.s: Late-night hosts reacted to Donald Trump's inflammatory comments about Iran bombing US cities as he continues to defend his war in the region.

stories.h: "Software Is Over": Bold AI Developer Takes Aim at Adobe with Open Source Clones
stories.s: Artcraft got its start last year as a "controllable AI for artists" that allows for precise post-generation.

stories.h: Microsoft Says New $2,599 Laptop with Nvidia Chip Outperforms MacBooks
stories.s: Microsoft claims its new Surface Laptop Ultra with an Nvidia chip outperforms MacBooks, but has published no test methodology.

stories.h: Jaguars to Play 26 of Next 30 Regular-Season Games Away from Jacksonville
stories.s: The Jaguars will play 26 of their next 30 regular-season games away from their home stadium in Jacksonville. This will be the first time an NFL team has played in 12 or more stadiums in a single season.

stories.h: Netflix's 8-Part Psychological Thriller Series Is Stranger Things Meets Ready or Not
stories.s: Netflix's new thriller series has been compared to Stranger Things and Ready or Not, making for a suspenseful binge. The show has been released earlier in 2026.

stories.h: It's Going to Be A Long Time Before We Get A New Halo Game
stories.s: A new report claims that a skeleton crew at Halo Studios is working on one last big content update for Halo: Campaign Evolved before the team will likely be completely cut and the studio closed.

stories.h: TP-Link Faces Legal Troubles in the US
stories.s: TP-Link is facing more legal troubles in the US as Florida and three other states filed lawsuits alleging that it lied to consumers about its connections to China and the risks of its routers.

stories.h: HBO's Lanterns Sets New DCU Rotten Tomatoes Audience Score Record After Finale
stories.s: HBO's Lanterns has set a new record for the DC Universe on Rotten Tomatoes, with a high audience score after its finale.

stories.h: Domestic Abuse Survivors Speak Out Against Far-Right UK Street Patrols
stories.s: Domestic abuse survivors are speaking out against the far-right UK street patrols, which they claim are abusive and controlling. Seven women shared their stories of abuse and control by their ex-partners.

stories.h: Windows Search Becomes Fastest Way to Control PC
stories.s: Windows Search is becoming the fastest way to control a PC.

stories.h: Warner and Paramount Merge to Form Skydance
stories.s: The merger of Warner and Paramount has formed Skydance, which will shake up the film industry. The big five have officially become the big four.

stories.h: International Oscar Submissions: China, Syria, Denmark, Italy, France and More Join the List
stories.s: China, Syria, Denmark, Italy, France, and more countries have submitted their entries for the 2027 Academy Awards. Final submissions are due by October 1.

stories.h: Star Wars: Zero Company Studio Brings Back Furloughed Developers
stories.s: The studio behind Star Wars: Zero Company is bringing back furloughed developers and working on new updates.

stories.h: AI Favors Brands with Active Social Media Presence
stories.s: A new study has found that maintaining an active presence on social media platforms can help brands increase their visibility in Google's artificial intelligence search results. Social platform links appeared in a majority of Google's AI search results.

stories.h: Mike Breen Apologizes for LeBron James Story
stories.s: Mike Breen apologized for causing a stir with an anecdote he shared while calling a preseason Knicks-Sixers game. The Philadelphia 76ers are going to be under a microscope all season.

stories.h: 'Ted Lasso': Brendan Hunt Breaks Down Season 4 Finale
stories.s: Brendan Hunt, co-creator and star of 'Ted Lasso', breaks down the Season 4 finale, including a 'passing the torch' moment and coaching team shakeup.

stories.h: Stephen A. Smith Apologizes for Lane Johnson Comments
stories.s: Stephen A. Smith has apologized for his comments on Lane Johnson's retirement, which sparked controversy over mental health.

stories.h: How Trading Cam Jurgens Impacts the Eagles' Salary Cap
stories.s: The Philadelphia Eagles gained draft capital by trading Cam Jurgens to Baltimore, but the deal provides limited immediate salary-cap relief and leaves the team with a substantial dead cap charge.

stories.h: Padres Closer Miller Returns from Paternity Leave
stories.s: Padres closer Mason Miller, who went on paternity leave, will be available to pitch in Game 4 against the Brewers after witnessing the birth of his first child.

stories.h: VPNs Become a Battleground in Social Media Control
stories.s: A group of tech companies and digital rights activists came together to launch a global campaign to preserve the right to use VPNs. Many people use VPNs to evade legislation targeting social media.

stories.h: Declan Rice Close to Agreeing New Arsenal Deal
stories.s: Declan Rice, an England midfielder, is close to agreeing a new long-term contract with Arsenal, becoming a crucial player for the Gunners since his transfer.
